OR Education: Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree in a field which demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work of the position, such as: Accounting, Financial Management, Business Administration.

Curvion Blue is a high-performance RevOps and sales augmentation company that helps businesses build and operate better revenue engines. Behind every strong revenue operation is strong financial visibility, and that’s where our accounting team comes in.

We work with multiple businesses and clients, which means our accounting team operates in a multi-company environment . Our Accounting Managers aren't responsible for just one set of books, one leadership team, or one monthly close. They are managing multiple clients, priorities, deadlines, accounting systems, and stakeholders at the same time.

That environment requires more than strong accounting fundamentals. It requires organization, judgment, communication, ownership, and the ability to keep a lot of moving pieces moving in the right direction.

You’ll oversee day-to-day accounting activity, review Staff Accountant work, manage month-end close, review financial statements, maintain accounting controls, identify issues, and work closely with Controllers to ensure they have accurate and reliable financial information.

Experience managing accounting for multiple companies at once is extremely important for this role. The ideal candidate has worked in a fractional accounting, outsourced accounting, public accounting, CAS, accounting firm, or similar multi-client environment where managing several sets of books simultaneously was part of the normal workflow.

You should be comfortable jumping between different businesses, accounting systems, stakeholders, deadlines, and financial situations without losing the plot. Basically: if you like one set of books, one close calendar, and one predictable workflow, this probably isn't your dream job. You SHOULD Apply If
You have experience managing accounting for multiple companies or clients simultaneously
You have worked in a fractional, outsourced, public accounting, CAS, accounting firm, or agency environment
You have strong full-cycle accounting experience and understand GAAP-based accrual accounting
You have experience owning or managing month-end close

You can manage competing deadlines across multiple businesses without needing someone to constantly tell you what to do next

You enjoy coaching and developing accounting professionals
You naturally look for ways to improve processes rather than accepting "that's how we've always done it"

You take ownership when something goes wrong and focus on solving the problem rather than assigning blame
You SHOULD NOT Apply If
Your experience has been exclusively within a single company's accounting department and you've never managed multiple companies or clients at once
You need a highly predictable workload with one set of books and one consistent workflow
You prefer purely transactional accounting and don't enjoy reviewing or developing other accountants

Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Ihrem Wissen und Ihren Fähigkeiten können Sie beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.
Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.
Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.
Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Generate project P&L reports for management

Ensure compliance with Saudi regulations (VAT, ZATCA, Zakat)

Calculate withholding tax (WHT) for international vendors

Support budgeting and forecasting cycles
Build dashboards for revenue performance by business line
Conduct variance analysis (actual vs. budget)

Oversee collections and monitor aging reports
Follow up on overdue receivables
Handle multi-currency transactions (SAR, USD, EUR)

Maintain audit documentation and trails
Support external audits

s.h: Ensure segregation of duties within Odoo

Supports the financial management and insurance fund operations of FCSIC, including accounting and financial reporting, internal control evaluation and administration, data analysis, investment and premium-related activities, and special projects.

Reviews and analyzes financial data; assists with the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports; ensures compliance with applicable federal laws, regulations, policies, and standards; and contributes to the development and documentation of policies and procedures.

Major duties include things such as: Reviews and evaluates financial data and transactions recorded in the financial management system, including posting entries and reconciliations of cash, investments, premium receivables, and other accounts.

Assists with the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and related reports, including FCSIC's Annual Report, government-wide and regulatory reporting such as Office of Management and Budget (OMB) data requests and year-end audited financial statements.

Analyzes trends in insurance obligations, Insurance Fund percentages, and projected investment income; coordinates with Farm Credit System (FCS) banks or Associations to obtain data or communicate information; and projects insurance premium assessments to FCS banks.

Drafts and updates policies, procedures, standard operating procedures (SOPs), Board materials, and other written reports and documents related to financial management, internal controls, and program operations.

Performs internal control risk assessments for FCSIC operations and the control environment pursuant to the Federal Managers' Financial Integrity Act (FMFIA) and other relevant guidance.

Designing, documenting, and testing internal controls over financial reporting; summarizing results; and supporting corrective actions to remediate control deficiencies.

Performing evaluations and risk assessments over financial reporting processes using a recognized internal control framework such as the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations Internal Control-Integrated Framework. Preparing audit requests, schedules/support and responding to auditor inquiries through fieldwork and closing.

Drafting clear accounting procedures or policy memos and communicating complex financial topics to non accountants to support decision-making.

Support integration of German operations into global financial infrastructure
Maintain organized documentation for internal and external stakeholders

We are seeking a versatile Senior Accountant to serve as a key bridge between our newly established Berlin manufacturing facility and our US financial operations.

In this dual-impact role, you will lead the cost accounting workflows and local compliance for our German entity (GmbH) while simultaneously supporting global cost accounting tasks, cross-border subsidiary reconciliations, and capital expenditure tracking.

You will partner with operational leaders to establish scalable standard costing methodologies, maintain inventory integrity across multiple locations, and ensure seamless financial alignment between EMEA and US teams.

Ideal candidates are detail-oriented professionals with background in multi-entity global structures who thrive in cross-functional environments.
This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Partners with Berlin Operations to establish scalable cost accounting workflows, standard costing methodologies, and manufacturing time-tracking for our local production line.
Leads monthly close processes for GmbH inventory, including raw materials, WIP, and finished goods reconciliations, while overseeing physical cycle counts and analyzing adjustments.
Ensures local accounting activities comply with German GAAP (HGB), prepares cost breakdowns for German R&D tax incentives (e.g., Forschungszulage ), and manages financial documentation for local government grants and subsidies.
Manages PCard reconciliations for lab equipment and flight materials while reviewing capital expenditure vs. operational expenses (CIP/Expense classifications) for the German entity.
Serves as the dedicated backup for US cost accountants during time-off, high-volume periods, and initial US-hours coverage through cross-training on US month-end workflows.
Reviews and clears consolidated transfer orders between international subsidiaries, managing movements between locations for both PBC and GmbH entities.
Maintains costs associated with satellite materials, launch, and build processes while tracking movements across inventory, WIP, and internal fixed asset materials.
Assists in labor capitalization tracking across internal software development, satellite construction, and commissioning efforts.
Performs purchase price variance (PPV), production variance, scrap, and Excess & Obsolete (E&O) analysis while preparing balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, and accrued purchases/prepaid manufacturing schedules for US and EMEA operations.
Supports internal and external audits across US GAAP, local German GAAP, and SOX controls.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (or a relevant German Ausbildung , e.g., Industriekaufmann/-frau , with specialized focus on accounting/controlling).
Proficiency with modern ERP systems and advanced capability in Excel or Google Sheets.
Professional fluency in both English and German.

Working knowledge of both US GAAP and German GAAP (HGB).
Direct hands-on experience with NetSuite ERP.

Prepare and review the Group's IFRS tax notes (IAS 12\) for interim and annual consolidated financial statements

Contribute to the continuous improvement and automation of tax reporting processes, templates, and account reconciliation controls
Maintain clear, audit\-ready documentation and supporting evidence for all tax positions and judgements

The Senior Accountant is responsible for overseeing the accurate, complete, and timely management of the organization's core disbursement accounting processes and international accounting statutory processes.

This includes comprehensive management and accounting for procure-to-pay (P2P) , employee expenses , fixed and intangible assets , and software capitalization .

The Senior Accountant will supervise an offshore team and be directly responsible for the accurate accounting and reconciliation of disbursement related expense, asset, and liability accounts.

Supervise Offshore Team: Manage and direct the daily activities of the offshore team (3 contractors) to ensure the complete, accurate, and timely processing of all vendor invoices and employee expense reports.
Procure-to-Pay (P2P): Oversee the full P2P cycle, from vendor file maintenance, invoice receipt and coding, payment disbursement, posting monthly accruals, and completing monthly reconciliations ensuring proper controls are maintained.
Employee Expenses: Manage the end-to-end employee expense reporting and reimbursement process, ensuring compliance with T&E policies and system optimization.
Help Desk: Serve as the primary point of contact for all AP and expense-related inquiries received via Slack and email, overseeing the team's responses to ensure timely and accurate resolution.
International Statutory Accounting: Work closely with our 3rd party accountants and auditors to ensure statutory accounting compliance for our Poland and UK entities.

Account Reconciliation: Own reconciling disbursement related accounts, including: Prepaid vendor expenses, prepaid rent, fixed assets, intangible assets, accumulated depreciation, lease accounts, A/P, Ramp liability, accrued expenses, and accrued litigation.
Fixed Assets: Manage the fixed asset lifecycle, including capitalization, depreciation, transfers, disposals, and reconciliation. Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of Fixed Assets and Depreciation. Properly account for all lease agreements.
Intangible Assets: Account for Intangible Assets and Amortization and Software Capitalization, ensuring compliance with GAAP/IFRS standards.
Month-End Close: Contribute to the month-end and quarter-end close processes, ensuring all disbursement-related entries and reconciliations are completed accurately, completely, and timely.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
4+ years of progressive experience in accounting function including AP supervisory experience.
ICAEW ACA, ACCA or CPA certification a plus.
Big 4 experience is a plus.
Previous experience at a technology company is a plus.
Proven experience overseeing P2P processes and supervising a team.
Knowledgeable of UK and Polish accounting principles and rules.
Netsuite, Ramp, Tipalti, and Slack system knowledge would be an advantage.
Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, prioritize appropriately, and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

This role is in the Financial Reporting and Accounting team, part of the Group Internal Finance team at Trustly, which also comprises Tax, Treasury, Payroll, Finance Operations and Finance Systems. The team is a dynamic and cross jurisdictional team, with an ethos of collaboration and continued improvement at its heart.

As a Senior Accountant at Trustly, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining the integrity of our financial statements, executing day to day general ledger accounting, and ensuring full regulatory and tax compliance across our US entities, based from our London office.
Working in a high growth FinTech environment, you will handle monthly financial closings, bank and account reconciliations, variance analysis, and internal controls under US GAAP. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail oriented accounting professional looking to step into an innovative global payments business and build scalable financial processes.

Month End Close: Execute month end, quarter end, and year end close routines, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and intercompany reconciliations in accordance with US GAAP.
Financial Reporting: Prepare accurate balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow reconciliations, investigating and resolving variances promptly.
Cash and Treasury Accounting: Monitor daily bank movements, perform bank reconciliations across multi currency accounts, and track working capital requirements.
Tax and Statutory Compliance: Support quarterly and annual US federal, state, and local tax filings (corporate income tax, sales and use tax, commercial rent tax) in coordination with external tax advisors.
Audit Management: Serve as a key point of contact for external auditors during annual financial audits, preparing audit schedules, documentation, and workpapers.
Process Improvement and Systems: Support the implementation, optimization, and automation of core financial systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, ERP platforms) and internal controls (SOX readiness).
Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner with US Payroll, FP&A, Accounts Payable, and Global Finance teams to streamline cross departmental financial inputs and reporting.

ACA qualified (or equivalent), alongside experience working with US GAAP.

Solid command of US GAAP principles, financial statement consolidation, and intercompany accounting.
Hands on experience with mid to enterprise ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Workday Accounting) and advanced Excel capabilities (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables).
Meticulous attention to detail, strong analytical capability, and the ability to operate independently in a fast paced environment.

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Dans le cadre d'un recrutement pour l'un de nos clients, groupe international actif dans le négoce de matières premières, nous recherchons un(e) Senior Trade Accountant pour renforcer son département Finance.
## Description du poste ##

s.h: Au sein du département, vous serez en charge de
s.t:
* Assurer le suivi comptable des opérations liées aux activités de trading.
* Contrôler l'impact comptable des transactions et assurer la fiabilité des résultats.
* Préparer et analyser les P&L liés aux opérations de trading.
* Effectuer les réconciliations entre Trading P&L et Accounting P&L et investiguer les éventuels écarts.
* Réconcilier les comptes du bilan : clients, fournisseurs, banques et opérations intercompany.
* Participer aux clôtures mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles.

* Participer activement au processus d'audit financier annuel.
* Garantir l'exactitude et l'intégrité des données comptables.
* Veiller au respect des normes IFRS et des procédures de contrôle interne.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Finance, Trading et les différentes fonctions de l'organisation.
* Contribuer aux analyses ad hoc et aux projets d'amélioration continue.
## Profil recherché ##
* Formation supérieure en Finance, Accounting ou équivalent.
* Environ 6 à 8 ans d'expérience dans un environnement Commodity Trading.
* Une exposition à un environnement Trading & Shipping constitue un réel avantage.
* Une expérience préalable en audit est appréciée.
* Solide maîtrise des normes IFRS.
* Très bonne compréhension du P&L, bilan, clôtures et réconciliations comptables.
* Bonne connaissance des systèmes comptables et des outils liés aux activités de trading.
* Excellente maîtrise d'Excel.
* Anglais courant indispensable, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
* Le français constitue un atout.
* Profil analytique, rigoureux et organisé, capable d'évoluer dans un environnement exigeant et international.
